message:
fix(host): re-derive the secure-input target rect on every capture restart; landing diag budget per episode

P9 (field 2026-09-07 14:27): the host read the primary monitor once at start -- under an RDP
session, 2236x1232 -- and handed that rect to the SYSTEM input agent for the life of the
process. Back on the 1920x1080 console the capture re-fit itself on every restart, the
agent's rect never did, and every UAC click landed x*1.165 / y*1.141 away (841,703 -> 979,802).

- host_input_target_rect.hpp: one pure rule. Desktop mode = the physical rect (origin
  included) of the monitor the capture session opened; window mode = 0x0 (the secure path
  never routes window-mode input; the agent then uses its live virtual screen); unknown =
  0x0. No DPI scaling: both ends are physical pixels.
- sync_input_target_rect() runs at startup and at the tail of restart_capture_session --
  RDP<->console, DXGI<->WGC<->GDI, monitor select and geometry changes all pass there -- and
  pushes to the broker only when the rect changed, logging
  "secure-input target rect=(x,y)/WxH source=... reason=...".
- RestartCaptureSessionImpl refreshes primary_monitor_info() for every desktop backend, not
  only DXGI; WGC's restart item and the GDI worker open the same primary.
- secure_input_diag_budget.hpp: the agent's "inject landed" lines are 12 per episode (a 2 s
  quiet gap refills) and 60 per minute, instead of 12 per agent process -- the 15:15 UAC
  left no record because the 14:27 agent had spent them.

Tests: remote60_host_input_target_rect_test (RDP->console transition, negative-origin and
4K-above monitors, window mode, unknown), secure_input_mapping_test +2 (the measured clicks
against the stale and the live rect; budget refill / no refill / per-minute ceiling).
Field: the actual UAC click still needs the user's eyes after install; multi-monitor untested.
Ledger, not fixed: a monitor selection reverts to the primary on the next restart.
